ja: ●轟の若き武将“陸遜ゼータプラス”がBB戦士に登場！ ●“跳燕機（ちょうえんき）”と本体が合体して飛行形態に組み換え変形可能 ●跳燕機の一部は盾と武器に組み換え可能 ●武器は“燕戟・宝旋霞（えんげき・ほうせんか）”が付属
en: -Todoroki's young military commander "Rikusun Zeta Plus" appears in BB Senshi! ●The “Chouenki” and the main body can be combined and transformed into a flying form. ●Part of the Choenki can be recombined into a shield and weapon. ●The weapon “Engeki/Hosenka” is included.
